# r/ripcity (post by hand; read the sub's self-promotion rules first)

**Title:** The Rise and Fall of Ja Morant: A statistical account, 2017–2026

**Body:**

Ja Morant went from the 97th percentile of the league in 2021-22 to playing 79 of 246 games since 2023.

Of his shooting collapse, 88% was shot-making, not shot selection.

His three-point slump covers 20-of-85 attempts: too few to tell decline from variance.

The one split that moved beyond doubt went up: his free throws, to .897.

Our verdict: #140 is a defensible price for the delivery risk. It is probably the wrong forecast of the talent.

Full article (free, no ads): https://thegravityreport.com/notes/morant/

Happy to answer questions about the method in the comments.
